page.content:
Family-run Broadway and touring landlord opposite the Shuberts.

How The Nederlander Organization connects

  • Topic: Broadway — The Nederlander Organization is a principal Broadway landlord.
  • Location: Richard Rodgers Theatre — The Nederlander Organization operates the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Location: Gershwin Theatre — The Nederlander Organization operates the Gershwin Theatre.

What is The Nederlander Organization?

The Nederlander Organization is the other large family landlord of Broadway houses, including the Gershwin (Wicked) and the main touring circuit that carries Broadway titles on the road.

Key threads lead to Broadway, Richard Rodgers Theatre and Gershwin Theatre.
